title: The Radio Wave
description: An introverted college student builds the courage to host her first live campus broadcast late at night.
character_reference: a college-age male with messy blonde hair, wearing a dark green vintage crewneck sweater and silver hoop earrings

scenes.narration: Midnight in the campus broadcast booth always felt heavier, like the whole world was listening.
scenes.visual: close up on glowing analog audio mixing board knobs in a dimly lit recording studio, fingers resting lightly on slider controls

scenes.narration: I adjusted the heavy headphones, watching the master volume meter flicker in absolute silence.
scenes.visual: medium shot putting on bulky black headphones, staring intently at glowing digital audio levels, soundproof foam wall panels background

scenes.narration: My throat went completely dry as my thumb hovered over the glowing red transmission toggle.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a glowing red toggle switch, trembling thumb hovering inches away, dark atmospheric studio lighting

scenes.narration: I took a deep breath, flipped the switch, and began speaking into the empty darkness.
scenes.visual: side profile speaking softly into a vintage black studio microphone, eyes closed in deep concentration, warm overhead desk lamp

scenes.narration: For the first twenty minutes, it felt like talking to myself in an echoing cave.
scenes.visual: medium shot leaning back in ergonomic studio chair, resting chin on hand with a thoughtful, questioning expression

scenes.narration: Then the studio phone blinked amber, shattering the isolation with a single unexpected call.
scenes.visual: close up on a retro telephone console with a blinking amber indicator light, dark wooden desktop surface

scenes.narration: Hearing someone say they needed that song tonight changed everything I thought about my voice.
scenes.visual: smiling broadly while pressing a telephone receiver to ear, leaning forward with sudden joyful energy, studio lighting

scenes.narration: Follow along for more stories of finding your voice in unexpected places.
scenes.visual: adjusting microphone arm with a confident smirk, looking directly into the camera lens, cozy glowing studio interior
